zh: 逐步建立、累積、增強

zh: n. 目的地, 終點

zh: 短途旅行、團體出遊

zh: n. 開支；消費；損失，代價；vt. 向…收取費用；vi. 被花掉
explain_en: the money that you spend on something

zh: v. 延長（期限）、擴展、延伸、提供（協助／感謝）

zh: 潛在的、未來的、預期的（prospective clients 潛在客戶）

zh: n. 形勢；情況〈正〉職業，職位，工作位置，環境

zh: ad；v. 本質上，實質上；大體上相當多地，大大地
explain_en: very much; a lot

zh: 系統、制度、體系
explain_en: an organized set of ideas or theories
example_en: The airline system covers the entire world with flights.

zh: n. 能力；力量智慧，才智；天資
explain_en: the fact that somebody / something able to do something
example_en: The designer's ability was obvious from her porfolio.

zh: vt. 應用；申請；塗，敷；vi. 申請；適用；請求；塗，敷

explain_en: to be fully prepared for a situation, event, or task

zh: 召來、請（專家）協助；打電話請假
explain_en: to ask to come, to beckon

zh: 信心、信任；機密（in confidence 保密地）
explain_en: the feeling that you can trust, believe in and be sure about the abilities or good qualities of somebody / something

zh: ad；v. 不斷地;時常地
explain_en: all the time; repeatedly

zh: 專家、行家；專業的
explain_en: a person with special knowledge, skill

zh: 後續追蹤、跟進
explain_en: to continue, to take additional steps

zh: 猶豫的、遲疑的

zh: vt. 呈現；介紹；提出；贈送；vi. 舉槍瞄準；adj. 出席的；現在的；n. 現在；禮物；瞄準
explain_en: to give something to somebody, especially formally at a ceremony

zh: 微弱地、無力地
explain_en: in a weak way

explain_en: to say “yes” to an offer, invitation, etc.

example_en: It took him over an hour to balance his checkbook.

zh: 謹慎地、小心地
explain_en: being careful about what you say or do

zh: 扣除、減除（如扣款或抵稅）
explain_en: to take away money, points, etc., from a total amount
example_en: By deducting the monthly fee from her checking account, Yi was able to make her account balance.

zh: 股利、紅利、股息
explain_en: an amount of the profits that a company pays to people who own shares in the company

zh: 頭期款、訂金

zh: 受限制的、限定的（restricted area 管制區）
explain_en: limited or small in size or amount

zh: n. 簽名, 簽字
explain_en: your name as you usually write it, for example at the end of a letter
example_en: The customer's signature was kept on file for identification purposes.

zh: 申辦（貸款／保險）、提領；外帶
explain_en: remove
example_en: When can I take money out of bank?

zh: 交易、帳務往來
explain_en: a piece of business that is done between people, especially an act of buying or selling
example_en: Banking transaction will appear on your monthly statement.

zh: 遵守、恪守（規定／原則／合約）
explain_en: to follow, to pay attention to

example_en: Newspapers have been accused of trying to set the agenda for the government.

zh: 提出（議題／建議）；提及
explain_en: to introduce a topic

zh: vt. 結束；推斷；決定，作結論；vi. 決定；推斷；斷定
explain_en: to decide or believe something as a result of what you have heard or seen.
example_en: After long discussions, the board has concluded that the project has to be canceled.

zh: 核准、放行（get the go-ahead 獲准進行）
explain_en: permission for somebody to start doing something.
example_en: The manager was just waiting for the go ahead from her boss before mailing the report.

zh: n. 球門進球得的分努力的物件, 目標
explain_en: purpose

zh: 漫長的、冗長的
explain_en: very long, and often too long, in time or size
example_en: After lengthy discussions, the chairperson was reelected for another term.

zh: 事項、問題、案件；要緊（動詞）
explain_en: a subject or situation that you must consider or deal with

zh: 定期地、週期性地
explain_en: happening fairly often and regularly
example_en: The group tried to meet periodically.

zh: n. 優先；優先權；優先次序；優先考慮的事

zh: n. 進步，發展；前進；vi. 進行；前進，進步

zh: 浪費；廢棄物（名詞）
explain_en: to use more of something than is necessary or useful

zh: 處理（問題）、發表演說；地址（名詞）
explain_en: a formal speech that is made in front of an audience

zh: vt. 避免；避開，躲避；消除
explain_en: to prevent something bad from happening

zh: vi. 舉行示威遊行(或集會)；vt. 說明, 演示論證, 證明顯示, 表露
explain_en: to show something clearly by giving proof or evidence
example_en: Let me demonstrate to you some of the difficulties we are facing.

zh: vt. 開發；使成長；進步；使顯影；vi. 發育；生長；顯露；進化
explain_en: to gradually grow or become bigger, more advanced
example_en: This job can give you an opportunity to develop new skills.

zh: vt. 評價, 估計, 估價
explain_en: to form an opinion of amount, value or quality of something
example_en: It's important to evaluate your competition when making a business plan.

zh: 收集（資料）、聚集
explain_en: to come together, or bring people together
example_en: We gathered information for our plan from many sources.

zh: 提案、報價、錄取通知（job offer）；提供（動詞）
explain_en: to say that you are willing to do something for somebody
example_en: Devon accepted our offer to write the business plan.

zh: 主要地、首要地
explain_en: mainly

zh: n. 危險(性)，風險引起危險的事物；vt. 冒險；冒…險
explain_en: the possibility of something bad happening at some time in the future

example_en: Do you intend to return the car to this location or to another location?

zh: n. 管道、入口；存取權限；vt. 存取（電腦檔案）、進入、取得
explain_en: the opportunity or right to use something

zh: n. 陳列, 展覽陳列的貨物、藝術品等；vt. 陳列, 展覽顯示, 顯露
explain_en: to put something in a place where people can see it easily

zh: 複製、複印；副本（名詞）
explain_en: to make an extract copy of something

zh: n. 失敗；故障；失敗者；破產
explain_en: lack of success in doing or achieving something
example_en: The success or failure of the plan depends on you.

zh: 弄清楚、算出、解決
explain_en: to calculate an amount or the cost
example_en: By examining all of the errors, the technicians were able to figure out how to fix the problem.

zh: 忽略、不理會
explain_en: to pay no attention to something

zh: 搜尋、尋找、調查
explain_en: an attempt to find somebody / something, especially by looking carefully for them /it
example_en: Our search of the database produced very little information.

zh: 關機、關閉、停業
explain_en: it stops being often for business
example_en: Please shut down the computer before you leave.

zh: n. 發出警告;受到告誡可引以為戒的事(或人)徵候;前兆(解僱、辭職等的)預先通知；adj. 警告的;告誡的;引為戒的
explain_en: a statement, an event, etc. telling somebody that something bad or unpleasant
example_en: The red flashing light gives a warning to users that the battery is low.

zh: 容納（人數）；配合（需求）；提供住宿
explain_en: to provide somebody with a room or place to sleep, live or sit
example_en: The meeting room was large enough to accommodate the various needs of the groups using it.

zh: n. 安排; 解決辦法約定; 協議佈置好的東西改編曲

example_en: I know that ASEAN stands for the Association of Southeast Asian Nations.

explain_en: to be present at an even

zh: n. 會議討論, 商談

zh: 取得聯絡（常搭配 with）
explain_en: to communicate / contact with somebody
example_en: As soon as we arrive at the hotel, we will get in touch with the manager about the unexpected guests.

zh: vt. 持有；儲存；擁有；拘留；約束或控制；vi. 持續；支援；有效；n. 保留；控制

zh: 地點、位置、據點
explain_en: a place where something happens or exists

zh: 過度擁擠的

example_en: Too many poor people are living in overcrowded conditions.

zh: vt. 記錄；註冊；登記；把…掛號；掛號郵寄；正式提出；vi. 登記；註冊；掛號；n. 註冊；登記簿；登記；記錄；暫存器
explain_en: to record somebody / something name on a list
example_en: You can register this mail for an additional $2.2.

zh: vt. 選擇；挑選；adj. 精選的，挑選出來的限制性的，選擇嚴格的
explain_en: to choose somebody / something from a group
example_en: They were selected to match her clothes.

zh: 會議場次、議程、時段
explain_en: a period of time that is spent doing a particular activity
example_en: The morning sessions tend to fill up first, so sign up early.

zh: 參與、參加
explain_en: to be involved in something
example_en: We could not get enough people to take part in the meeting, so we canceled it.

zh: 遵守、恪守（規定／合約）
explain_en: to accept and act according to a law, an agreementt

zh: n. 協定, 協議, 契約達成協議同意

example_en: According to the agreement, the caterer will also supply the flowers for the event.

zh: n. 保證, 擔保, 確信把握, 信心(人壽)保險
explain_en: a statement that something will certainly be true or will certainly happen

zh: 建立、創立、制定
explain_en: to start or create an organization, a system

zh: 使負有義務、約束（be obligated to 有義務…）
explain_en: to bind legally or morally

zh: n. 學徒, 徒弟

zh: v. 組織，實施，進行；指揮（音樂）；帶領，引導；舉止，表現；傳導（熱或電）；n. 行為舉止；管理（方式），實施（辦法）；引導

zh: 跟上（進度／趨勢）、保持同步
explain_en: to stay equal with
example_en: Employees are encouraged to take courses in order to keep up with new developments.

zh: 敬仰、尊敬
explain_en: to admire
example_en: Staff members look up to the director because he has earned their respect over the years.

zh: 職場導師、指導前輩
explain_en: a person who gives a younger or less experienced person help and advice over a period of time, especially at work or school
example_en: She is a friend and mentor to many children.

zh: 按計畫進行中、步上正軌
explain_en: progressing according to plan and likely to achieve the intended result
example_en: They're on track to make record profits

zh: vt. 拒絕；抵制；丟棄；排斥；n. 被棄之物或人；次品
explain_en: to refuse to accept or consider something

zh: 設立、建立、安排（會議／系統）
explain_en: to establish, to arrange
example_en: You should set up a time and place for the meeting and then inform everyone who is involved.

zh: 成功、成就
explain_en: the fact that you have achieved something that you want and have been trying to do
example_en: The director's success came after years of hiring the right people at the right time.

zh: n. 訓練；培養；瞄準；整枝；v. 訓練；教養（train的ing形式）
explain_en: the process of learning the skills that you need to do a job

zh: vt. 更新；校正，修正；使現代化；n. 更新；現代化

example_en: The personnel officer updated the employees on the latest personnel changes.

zh: vt. & vi. 許可進入承認, 供認
explain_en: to permit to enter
example_en: She admits being strict with her children.

zh: 授權、核准
explain_en: to give official permission for something

zh: vt. 指派, 委任標明, 指明, 命名
explain_en: a person or group of people or vehicles that travels with someone or something in order to protect or guard them
example_en: This floor has been designated a no-smoking area.

zh: 護送人員、陪同者；護送（動詞）

zh: 醫院

zh: vt. 認出，識別支援，同情；vt. & vi. 等同於；有關聯
explain_en: to recognize someone or something and be able to say who or what they are
example_en: The tiny bracelets identified each baby in the nursery.

zh: 任務、使命、宗旨（mission statement 企業使命宣言）

example_en: The nurse explained that the mission of everyone in the unit was to make sure the patients got well as soon as possible.

zh: vi. 許可；允許；vt. 允許；許可；n. 執照、許可證，執照
explain_en: to allow someone to do something or to allow something to happen

zh: 相關的、切題的（常搭配 to）
explain_en: appropriate to a particular situation
example_en: He should speak a pertinent problem.

zh: n. 程式, 步驟手續

example_en: Call the hospital to schedule this procedure for tomorrow.

zh: 結果、成果；導致（result in）

explain_en: a document setting out items of debit and credit between a bank or other organization and a customer
example_en: My bank sends me monthly statement.

zh: 通常、一般而言
explain_en: in the way that is usual or normal; most often
example_en: I'm usually home by 6 o'clock.

zh: adj. 超前的, 先進的高階的, 高等的

zh: vt. 預料；預期認為(某事)會發生；認為(某人)會來；預計理應得到；期望，期待；期盼猜想；認為某事是真實的
explain_en: to think or believe that something will happen

zh: 飯店、旅館

zh: 通知、告知

zh: 報價（quotation）；引用

zh: n. 費率、比率、匯率、速度、價格；v. 評估、評等
explain_en: a measurement of the speed at which something happens

zh: 預約、訂房、訂位
explain_en: an arrangement for a seat on a plane or train, a room in a hotel, etc. to be kept for you

zh: n. 服務，服侍；服役；儀式；adj. 服現役的；服務性的；耐用的；vt. 維修，檢修；保養
explain_en: useful function
example_en: The food was good but the service was very slow.

zh: n. 調整，調節調節器調解調節，順應；調節度，順應度(保險索賠等的)金額理算略有損壞商品等的)調低價格；adj. 能治癒的；可康復的(生理或道德)健康的

example_en: Let's see how many products we can count in advance of inventory so we disturb fewer customers.

explain_en: the state of being legally responsible for something
example_en: The slippery steps were a terrible liability for the store.

zh: 反映、體現；深思、檢討
explain_en: a sign that shows the state or nature of something

explain_en: to operate or function
example_en: As long as the computer is running, you can keep adding new data.

zh: 掃描（條碼／文件）；快速瀏覽
explain_en: to look at every part of something carefully, especially because you are looking for a particular thing or person

zh: 減去、扣除

zh: 繁瑣的、冗長乏味的

zh: 核實、驗證、確認
explain_en: to check that something is true or accurate

explain_en: acting with force and determination in order to succeed.

zh: 態度、看法

example_en: Each person has his or her own attitude towards life.

zh: vt. 犯罪；犯錯承諾；使自己受約束託付；交付

zh: n. 基金，專款現款；資金儲備，蘊藏；vt. 為…提供資金，給…撥款

zh: n. 費用、收費；負責、掌管；控告；v. 收費、刷卡記帳、充電

example_en: What did they charge for the repairs?

example_en: Embarrassed at his behavior, he rectified the situation by writing a letter of apology.

zh: 相稱的、相當的（commensurate with experience 薪資依經驗面議）

zh: 匹配、相配的人選；配合（動詞）
explain_en: a fit, a similarity

explain_en: to draw by appeal

zh: vt. 比較；對照；比喻為；vi. 相比；比較；n. 比較
explain_en: to examine people or things to see how they are similar and how they are different

zh: 具生產力的、高效率的、成果豐碩的

example_en: The managers had a very productive meeting and were able to solve many of the problems.

zh: 滿意、滿意度（customer satisfaction 顧客滿意度）
explain_en: the good feeling that you have when you have achieved something

zh: n. 工作, 任務分配, 指派

zh: 選擇、挑選

zh: n. 決定, 決心, 判斷果斷, 堅決決議, 結果
explain_en: a choice or judgment that you make after thinking

explain_en: not giving enough thought to other people's feeling or needs
example_en: The manager inconsiderately scheduled the meeting for late Friday afternoon.

zh: n. 前廳, 廳堂議會休息室遊說議員的團體；vt. & vi. 向…進行遊說[疏通]
explain_en: a large area inside the entrance of a public building where people can meet and wait
example_en: The reception area was moved from the lobby of the building to the third floor.

zh: 升遷、晉升；將（會議／日期）提前
explain_en: to advance, improve position
example_en: In order to move up in the company, employees had to demonstrate their loyalty.

zh: 願意接受…的、對…持開放態度
explain_en: willing to consider or accept new ideas, suggestions, or possibilities
example_en: Since the junior executive was still on probation, he was open to much scrutiny and criticism.

zh: 選擇、決定（opt for / opt out of 退出）
explain_en: to choose, to decide on
example_en: The operations manager opted for the less expensive office design.

zh: 仔細審查、嚴密檢視
explain_en: careful and thorough examination
example_en: Jim left his old job because he found it difficult to work under the close scrutiny of his boss.

zh: n. 商標, 牌子烙印；vt. 打烙印於, 以烙鐵打加汙名於, 譴責
explain_en: a type of product made by a particular company
example_en: All brands of aspirin are the same.

zh: 遵守、符合（標準／法規，常搭配 to）
explain_en: to behave and think in the same way as most other people in a group or society
example_en: Our safety standards conform to those established by the government.

zh: 瑕疵、缺陷（產品品管）
explain_en: a fault in something
example_en: Because of a defect in cable, the phone was returned.

zh: vt. 提高, 增加, 加強
explain_en: to increase or further improve the good quality, value, or status of someone or something
example_en: This is an opportunity to enhance the reputation of the company.

zh: 服裝、衣物（成衣業用語）
explain_en: a piece of clothing
example_en: Portland garment factory was established in 2008.

zh: vt. 檢查；視察；檢閱；vi. 進行檢查；進行視察
explain_en: to look closely at something or someone, especially to check that everything is as it should be.
example_en: Children's car seats are thoroughly inspected and tested for safety before being put on the market.

zh: 有洞察力的、敏銳的
explain_en: having or showing the ability to see or understand things quickly, especially things that are not obvious
example_en: It takes a perceptive person to be a good manager.

zh: 排斥、抵制、防（水／蟲）
explain_en: to make somebody feel horror or disgust
example_en: Faulty products repel repeat customers.

zh: 退回、收回（商品或說過的話）
explain_en: to return something
example_en: The quality inspector took the shoddy work back to the assembly line to confront the workers.

zh: 丟棄、淘汰；駁回（提案）
explain_en: to get rid of something that is no longer wanted or needed
example_en: You'll be thrown out if you don't pay the rent.

zh: 一致地、均勻地、統一地
explain_en: the same in all parts and at all times
example_en: The principles were applied uniformly across all the departments.

zh: 皺摺、皺紋；小問題
explain_en: a line or small fold in your skin, especially on your face, that forms as you get older
example_en: A wrinkle in the finish can be repaired more economically before a sale than after.

zh: 憂慮的、擔心的、不安的
explain_en: worried or frightened that something unpleasant may happen
example_en: The mortgage lender was apprehensive about the company's ability to pay.

zh: 情況、環境、狀況（under no circumstances 絕不）
explain_en: the conditions and facts that are connected with and affect a situation, an event, or an action
example_en: Under the current economic circumstances, they will not be able to purchase the property.

zh: n. 狀況，狀態；地位健康狀況，可使用的狀況條件，先決條件環境，情況疾病；vt. 制約，限制使習慣於，使適應
explain_en: the state that something is in
example_en: Except for some minor repairs, the building is in very good condition.

zh: 由於、因為（介系詞片語，後接名詞）
explain_en: because of
example_en: Due to the low interest rates, good office space is difficult to find.

zh: 波動、起伏不定
explain_en: to change frequently in size, amount, quality, etc., especially from one extreme to another
example_en: No one is very comfortable making a large investment while the currency values fluctuate almost daily.

zh: 擺脫、退出、避免（合約／責任）
explain_en: to exit, escape
example_en: The company wanted to get out of the area before property values declined even further.

zh: 指標、指示器、跡象
explain_en: a sign that shows you what something is like or how a situation is changing
example_en: If the economy is an accurate indicator, rental prices will increase rapidly in the next six months.

zh: 租約；承租、出租
explain_en: a legal agreementt that allows you to use a car, a building
example_en: They decided to lease the property rather than buy it.

zh: 受限於、鎖定於（長期合約／利率）
explain_en: to commit, to be unable to change
example_en: Before you lock yourself into something, check all your options.

zh: 占用、使用（空間／時間）；擔任（職位）
explain_en: to fill or use a space, an area, or an amount of time
example_en: Our company has occupied this office for more than five years.

zh: n. 選擇權；選項；[經]買賣的特權
explain_en: something that you can choose to have or do
example_en: With the real estate market so tight right now, you don't have that many options.

zh: 須受…規範、視…而定、易遭受（subject to approval 須經核准）
explain_en: under legal power, dependent
example_en: This contract is subject to all the laws and regulations of the state.

zh: 基礎、根據、準則（on a regular basis 定期地）
explain_en: the reason why people take a particular action
example_en: The manager didn't have any basis for firing the employee.

zh: 察覺到、意識到、知道
explain_en: to be conscious of
example_en: Are you aware of the new employee's past work history?

zh: vt. & vi. 有益於, 得益；n. 益處, 好處救濟金, 保險金；also benefitted benefitingbenefitting benefitsbenefits
explain_en: an advantage that something gives you
example_en: The discovery of oil brought many benefits to the country.

zh: 補償、賠償、給付報酬
explain_en: to provide something good to balance or reduce the bad effects of damage, loss
example_en: If you are injured in a traffic accident, you can be compensated for your losses.

zh: 細緻地、謹慎地、巧妙地
explain_en: easily damaged or broken
example_en: The manager delicately asked about the health of his client.

zh: 符合資格的、合格的（be eligible for）
explain_en: able to participate in something, qualified
example_en: Who is eligible to become president?

zh: 彈性地、靈活地
explain_en: able to change to suit new conditions or situations
example_en: My manager thinks flexibly, enabling herself to solve many sticky problems.

zh: 談判、協商、議價
explain_en: to try to reach an agreementt by formal discussion
example_en: You must know what you want and what you can accept when you negotiate a salary.

zh: v. 提高、籌募、提出（問題）；n. 加薪、調薪
explain_en: n: an increase in salary; v: to move up
example_en: The government plans to raise taxes.

zh: vt. & vi. 退職；退役；(使)退休；vi. 退下；撤退就寢
explain_en: to stop doing your job, especially because you have reached a particular age
example_en: She was forced to retire early from teaching because of ill health.

zh: 既得的、依法賦予的（vested interest 既得利益）
explain_en: to give somebody the legal right or power to do something
example_en: The day that Ms. Weng became fully vested in the retirement plan, she gave her two weeks' notice.

zh: n. 薪資、時薪／週薪；vt. 發動、進行
explain_en: a regular amount of money that you earn, usually every week, for work
example_en: Hourly wages have increase by 20 percent over the last two years.

zh: vi. 呼籲，懇求；有吸引力，迎合愛好；訴諸，求助；上訴；（體育比賽中）訴諸裁判；n. 上訴；吸引力，感染力；呼籲，請求；訴諸裁判；vt. [美]將…上訴，對…上訴
explain_en: the ability to attract
example_en: A restaurant with good food and reasonable prices has a lot of appeal.

zh: 抵達、到達
explain_en: to reach a destination
example_en: What time do you arrive at the airport?

zh: n. 妥協, 折中方法；vi. 折中解決；vt. 連累, 危害, 損害
explain_en: an agreementt made between two people or groups in which each side gives up some of the things they want so that both sides are happy at the end
example_en: After lengthy talks the two sides finally reached a compromise.

zh: 大膽地、勇敢地
explain_en: brave; willing to do dangerous
example_en: We daringly ordered the raw squid.

zh: 熟悉的（be familiar with）
explain_en: well known to you
example_en: It's nice to see some familiar items on the menu.

zh: 指南、手冊；導覽員、引導
explain_en: a person who shows other people the way to a place
example_en: I don't know where to go, so why don't we consult the guide.

zh: 大多數、多數（the majority of）
explain_en: the largest part of a group of people or things
example_en: The majority of the group wanted to try the new Chinese restaurant.

zh: 混合、組合；混合（動詞）
explain_en: if two or more substances mix or you mix them, they combine, usually in a way that means they cannot easily be separated
example_en: The mix of bright colors on the plate was very pleasing.

zh: 依賴、仰賴、信賴（rely on）
explain_en: to need or depend on someone or something
example_en: I seldom rely on the restaurant reviews in the paper when choosing a restaurant.

zh: 安全的、穩固的；取得、確保（動詞）
explain_en: safe from danger or risk; fixed firmly; to obtain or guarantee
example_en: At last they were able to feel secure about the future.

zh: 主觀的
explain_en: based on your own ideas or opinions rather than facts, and therefore sometimes unfair
example_en: The reviews in this guidebook are highly subjective, but fun to read.

zh: n. 建議, 意見細微的跡象
explain_en: an idea or a plan that you mention for someone else to think about
example_en: Thank you so much for your suggestion.

zh: 準確地、精確地
explain_en: correct and true in every detail
example_en: The teacher evaluates student's ability accurately.

zh: 貨運公司、航空公司、電信業者
explain_en: a company that carries goods or passengers from one place to another, especially by air
example_en: Lou, our favorite carrier, takes extra care of our boxes marked 'fragile'.

zh: 編目、建檔；產品型錄（名詞）
explain_en: to make a systematic list of items; a complete list of items for sale
example_en: Ellen cataloged the complaints according to severity.

zh: vt. 履行；滿足；實現；使結束（等於fulfil）；also fulfils
explain_en: to do or achieve what was hoped for or expected
example_en: I fulfilled my promise to treat him to dinner.

zh: 不可或缺的、關鍵組成的
explain_en: being an essential part of something
example_en: The battery is an integral part of a watch and without it you would not know the time.

zh: 庫存、存貨、盤點清單
explain_en: a written list of all the objects, furniture, etc. in a particular building
example_en: The store closes one day a year so that the staff can take inventory of the stockroom.

zh: 將…降至最低、最小化
explain_en: to reduce something, especially something bad, to the lowest possible level
example_en: The authority must find urgent solutions to minimize pollution.

zh: 手邊現有的、現貨供應的
explain_en: available
example_en: Do you have any aspirin on hand?

zh: 記得、記住
explain_en: to have or keep an image in your memory of an event, a person, a place, etc. from the past
example_en: Please remember to turn off the light before you go home.

zh: 出貨、運送、寄送
explain_en: to send
example_en: Eva shipped the package carefully, since she knew the contents were made of glass.

zh: 足夠地、充分地
explain_en: enough for a particular purpose; as much as you need
example_en: Two stars are sufficiently close together.

zh: vt. 供給，供應；n. 供給，供應，補給供給物，供應品；儲備物質；糧食，生活用品
explain_en: an amount of something that is provided or available to be used.
example_en: By making better use of our supply, we can avoid ordering until next month.

zh: n. 交易；契約；特價商品；vi. 討價還價；成交；vt. 討價還價；拿…做交易
explain_en: to discuss prices, with somebody in order to reach an agreementt that is acceptable
example_en: Lois compared the sweaters carefully to determine which was a better bargain.

zh: 承擔（費用／責任）、忍受
explain_en: to be able to accept and deal with something unpleasant
example_en: Moya doesn't like crowds so she cannot bear shopping during the holiday rush.

zh: 行為、舉止、表現（美式拼法 behavior）
explain_en: the way that somebody behaves, especially towards other people
example_en: Suspicious behaviour in a department store will draw the attention of the security guards.

zh: n. 檢驗；結帳臺；簽出；檢出
explain_en: the place where you pay for the things that you are buying in a supermarket
example_en: The line at this checkout is too long, so let's look for another.

zh: 舒適、安逸；安慰
explain_en: the state of being physically relaxed or having a pleasant life
example_en: I like to dress for comfort if I'm spending the day shopping.

zh: vt. 擴張；使膨脹；詳述；vi. 張開，展開；發展
explain_en: to become greater in size, number or importance
example_en: The telephone networks in rural areas should be expanded.

zh: vt. 探測；探索；探險；vi. 探測；探險；探索
explain_en: to examine something completely or carefully to find out more about it
example_en: Reading history books is like exploring the past.

zh: n. 一項，一件，一條；專案
explain_en: one thing on a list of things to buy, do, talk about, etc
example_en: Do you think I can get all these items into one bag?

zh: 強制性的、必備的
explain_en: required by law
example_en: The jewelry store has a mandatory policy of showing customers only one item at a time.

zh: 商品、貨品（不可數名詞）
explain_en: goods that are bought or sold; goods that are for sale in a shop / store
example_en: I am very impressed with the selection of merchandise at this store.

zh: n. 一次購物中買來的東西買東西, 購物
example_en: Let's go shopping.

zh: 嚴格地、完全地
explain_en: with a lot of control and rules that must be obeyed
example_en: Our store strictly enforces its return policy.

zh: n. 趨勢, 傾向流行
explain_en: a general diretion in which a situation is changing or developing
example_en: The youth try to keep up with the fashion trend.

zh: n. 計算，計算(的結果)推斷；預測，估計盤算，深思熟慮，慎重的計劃自私的打算；算計
explain_en: the act or process of using numbers to find out an amount
example_en: According to my calculations, I'll owe less money on my income taxes this year.

zh: n. 截止期限，最後期限
explain_en: a point in time by which something must be done
example_en: The deadline for paying this years's taxes is just two weeks away.

zh: n. 檔案、資料夾、卷宗；v. 歸檔、提出（申請／訴訟）
explain_en: to present something so that it can be officially recorded and dealt with
example_en: to file a claim / complaint / petition / lawsuit (How to File a Lawsuit)

zh: 填寫（表格／申請書）
explain_en: to complete
example_en: I usually ask someone to help me fill out my tax form.

zh: 放棄、停止
explain_en: to quit, to stop
example_en: Ms. Gomez is so optimistic that she never wants to give up.

zh: n. 關節；接合處，接合點；接縫；（牛，羊等的腿）大塊肉；adj. 聯合的，合辦的；共同的；連線的；vt. 連線，貼合；接合；使有接頭；vi. 貼合；生節
explain_en: involving two or more people together
example_en: They were joint owners of the house (= they owned it together).

zh: vt. 欠…債；應當給予應把…歸功於感激
explain_en: return money that you have borrowed
example_en: I owe Janet ten pounds.

zh: 罰款、罰金、處罰
explain_en: a punishment for breaking a law, rule, or contract
example_en: The penalty for travelling without a ticket is $200.

zh: 準備、籌備（tax preparation 報稅準備）
explain_en: the act or process of getting ready for something or making something ready
example_en: They are making preparations for war.

zh: 退款、退費
explain_en: a sum of money that is paid back to you, especially because you paid too much or because you returned goods to a store
example_en: With the tax refund, we bought two plane tickets.

zh: 配偶（夫或妻）
explain_en: a husband or wife
example_en: My spouse prepares the tax return for both of us.

zh: 預扣（稅款）、扣留、保留不給
explain_en: to refuse to give something to someone
example_en: Do not withhold any information from your accountant or he will not be able to prepare your tax form correctly.

zh: 行動、措施（take action 採取行動）；情節
explain_en: the events in a story, play, etc
example_en: I like action films.

zh: vt. & vi. 接近，走近，靠近；vt. 接洽，交涉；著手處理；n. 靠近，接近，臨近通路，入口，途徑方式，方法
explain_en: to come near to someone or something in distance or time
example_en: If you look out of the window, you will see the sun approaching.

zh: n. 觀眾；聽眾；接見；讀者
explain_en: people who have gathered to watch or listen to something (a play, concert, someone speaking, etc.)
example_en: Millions of audiences all over the world enjoy this programme.

zh: 具創意的、創造性的
explain_en: involving the use of skill and the imagination to produce something new or a work of art
example_en: You are so creative! I have never seen any pictures like this before.

zh: 對話、對白、溝通交流
explain_en: conversations in a book, play, or movie
example_en: The actors performed the dialogue without using scripts.

zh: 要素、元素、成分
explain_en: a necessary or typical part of something
example_en: The audience is an essential element of live theater.

zh: n. 經驗，體驗經歷；閱歷；感受，體會；vt. 經歷，體驗；感受，遭受
explain_en: the knowledge and skill that you have gained through doing something for a period of time
example_en: Do you have any experience in teaching children?

zh: vi. 發生；舉行；存在被發現；想到[起]
explain_en: to happen
example_en: The tsunami occurred at about 3.30 p.m.

zh: vt. 執行；完成；演奏；vi. 表演；執行，機器運轉
explain_en: to do something, such as a piece of work, task, or duty
example_en: A water puppet show is performed in a pool.

zh: vt. 排練；預演；vi. 排練；演習
explain_en: to practice or make people practice a play, piece of music, etc. in preparation for a public performance
example_en: Today, we'll just rehearse the final scene.

zh: n. 回顧；檢查；檢討；重新考慮評論性刊物，評論檢閱；vt. 回顧；vt. & vi. 寫…的評論文章
explain_en: an examination of something, with the intention of changing it if necessary
example_en: The film received generally positive reviews.

zh: 售罄、賣光
explain_en: to sell all the tickets
example_en: The tickets sold out within hours.

zh: 全面的、詳盡的
explain_en: including all, or almost all, the items, details, facts, information, etc., that may be concerned
example_en: Our travel agent gave us a comprehensive travel package, including rail passes.

zh: adj. 豪華的，奢華的；高階的ad；v. 豪華地
explain_en: luxurious
example_en: My parents decided to splurge on deluxe accommodations for their trip.

zh: n. 人名地址錄, (電話)號碼簿
explain_en: a book containing lists of information, usually in alphabetical order
example_en: We consulted the directory to see where the train station was located.

zh: n. 持續
explain_en: the length of time that something lasts or continues
example_en: Mother lent me her spare jacket for the duration of the trip.

zh: vt. 稱做…；定名為…；給…稱號；使…有權利
explain_en: to give someone the right to have or to do something
example_en: During the holiday rush, a train ticket entitled the passenger to a ride, but not necessarily a seat.

zh: n. 費, 票價乘客食物；vi. 吃, 進食進展, 遭遇
explain_en: the money that you pay to travel by bus, plane, taxi, etc.
example_en: Pay your fare at the ticket office and you will get a ticket to board the train.

zh: 抵銷、彌補（成本／損失）
explain_en: to use one cost, payment, or situation in order to cancel or reduce the effect of another
example_en: The high cost of the hotel room offset the savings we made by taking the train instead of the plane.

zh: vi. 運轉；動手術；起作用；vt. 操作；經營；對…開刀；引起
explain_en: to work in a particular way
example_en: The train only operates in this area at the height of the tourist season.

zh: 準時地
explain_en: happening at the arranged or correct time
example_en: Please be on time; the train leaves punctually at noon.

zh: 相對地、比較起來
explain_en: to a fairly large degree
example_en: The train is relatively empty for this time of day.

zh: 剩餘部分、餘額、其餘的人
explain_en: the remaining people, things, or time
example_en: The Alaskan frontier has train service in the summer, but for the remainder of the year the tracks are impassable.

zh: 偏遠的；遠端的（remote work 遠端工作）
explain_en: far away from places where other people live
example_en: We took the train out of the city and found a remote hotel in the country for the weekend.

zh: 火車、列車；訓練（動詞）
explain_en: a connected series of railroad cars; to teach skills for a job
example_en: We love travelling by train.

zh: adj. 典型的；特有的；表示特性的；n. 特徵；特性；特色
explain_en: very typical of something or of somebody's character.
example_en: One characteristic of the store is that it is slow in mailing refund checks.

zh: n. 結果, 後果重要(性), 重大
explain_en: a result of something that has happened
example_en: As a consequence of not having seen a dentist for several years, Lydia had several cavities.

zh: vt. & vi. 考慮；vt. 把…看作, 認為關心, 體諒, 顧及
explain_en: to think about something carefully
example_en: You shouldn't consider marrying a man for his money.

zh: 涵蓋、包含（保固／保險）；負擔費用；報導
explain_en: to include something; to deal with something
example_en: The passport is covered with leather.

zh: n. 滿期，屆期；截止，告終呼氣，吐氣；(氣的)撥出；撥出物；噓出的聲音
explain_en: an ending of the period of time when an official document can be used
example_en: Have you checked the expiration date on this yogurt?

zh: 頻繁地、經常地
explain_en: often
example_en: Appliances frequently come with a one-year warranty.

zh: vt. 暗示；意味；隱含
explain_en: to suggest that something is true without saying so directly
example_en: The guarantees on the Walkman imply that all damages were covered under warranty for one year.

zh: 承諾、保證
explain_en: to tell somebody that you will definitely do or not do something
example_en: Please promise not to tell anyone!

zh: vt. 保護，防衛；警戒
explain_en: to make sure that somebody / something is not harmed, injured
example_en: Consumer laws are designed to protect the public against unscrupulous vendors.

zh: 聲譽、口碑、名聲
explain_en: the opinion that people have about what s.b/s.th is like, based on what has happened in the past
example_en: Hogwarts is a school with an excellent reputation.

zh: vt. 要求；需要；命令
explain_en: to need something; to depend on s.b / s.th
example_en: The law requires that each item clearly display the warranty information.

zh: n. 品種, 種類種種, 各種變化, 多樣化
explain_en: different sorts of the same thing
example_en: Thanks to the development of the media, people have more chances to see a variety of programs.
